title: Ankhorage Color Theory
summary: Provides standalone color harmony, swatch, contrast, and theme color generation utilities.
purpose: Give applications reusable color-theory operations without owning their rendering or design-system policy.
responsibilities: Generate harmonies, swatches, contrast data, and theme colors.
Expose color utility entrypoints including Culori-compatible helpers.
boundaries: Does not own an application's design tokens or theme policy.
audience: Applications and design tools that need reusable color calculations.
useCases: Evaluate contrast and derive theme colors.

invariants: Color calculations remain reusable across browser and React Native consumers.

limitations: Consumers choose how generated colors are stored and rendered.
